era: 2019 Yandex (same for every visitor): minimal search home (yandex.com and ya.ru) with the red-Y wordmark left of a square search field with a 2px #fc0 border and a yellow arrow-shaped Search/Найти button, service icons above and region/weather/rates informers on the Russian page; results page with the Яндекс wordmark, the same yellow field and Найти button, a filter icon, grey 13px service tabs with the current one in bold black, #1a0dab titles, green #070 URLs and #333 snippets. Wayback is unreachable from the cloud and the user's Mac was disconnected, so the sources are Arquivo.pt 2019 captures and a dated 2019 article screenshot.
